name: cubesmart-twilio-guided-move-in
description: CubeSmart + Twilio | Guided Move-In Journey — an interactive presentation of how Twilio's communications platform embeds inside CubeSmart's KORE platform (Voice, Verify, ConversationRelay, Branded Calling + Voice Insights, RCS, WhatsApp, Conversations unified inbox, Memory, Conversational Intelligence), a reference architecture for the KORE integration layer, the CubeSmart AI-Native Communications Adoption Arch (three independently-maturing streams — Messaging, Voice, and AI — plus a DIY/Flex SDK toggle), and the Guided Move-In Journey — a fully functional thirteen-beat, four-act narrative demo running live to a real handset over branded RCS (with per-message channel verification so an SMS fallback is never mistaken for RCS), SMS and inbound voice AI, personalised by-name call greetings, 1/7/30-day extended gate-access windows, a Unified Profile built in Twilio Memory, and real-time Conversation Intelligence that keeps scoring the call after it is handed to a human — Real-Time Transcription takes over from ConversationRelay in the same conversation, so the operators coach the live Flex agent mid-sentence, write a Retention Risk Threshold Reached event straight back to the tenant's profile when her score crosses 60, and release a playbook-grounded save (20% rent discount for 3 months, or a unit downsize) onto the live TaskRouter task, rendered on the agent desktop by a purpose-built Twilio Flex plugin.
